project.name: Desktop Pet v3.1 - Payment live control

requirements.text: pay(balance, amount) must return True when amount is positive and balance is greater than or equal to amount. It must return False when a nonnegative balance is less than the positive amount.
pay must raise ValueError for a negative balance or a zero or negative amount.

scenarios.title: Payment succeeds when balance equals or exceeds positive amount
scenarios.gherkin:
Feature: Payment balance checks
Scenario Outline: Payment succeeds when the balance covers the amount
Given a nonnegative balance of <balance> and a positive amount of <amount>
When I call pay with that balance and amount
Then the result is True
Examples:
| balance | amount |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 1 |

scenarios.title: Payment fails when nonnegative balance is less than positive amount
scenarios.gherkin:
Feature: Payment balance checks
Scenario Outline: Payment returns false when funds are insufficient
Given a nonnegative balance of <balance> and a positive amount of <amount>
When I call pay with that balance and amount
Then the result is False
Examples:
| balance | amount |
| 0 | 1 |
| 1 | 2 |

scenarios.title: Payment raises ValueError for negative balances
scenarios.gherkin:
Feature: Invalid payment inputs
Scenario Outline: Negative balance is rejected
Given a negative balance of <balance> and a positive amount of 1
When I call pay with that balance and amount
Then pay raises ValueError
Examples:
| balance |
| -1 |
| -2 |

scenarios.title: Payment raises ValueError for zero or negative amounts
scenarios.gherkin:
Feature: Invalid payment inputs
Scenario Outline: Nonpositive amount is rejected
Given a nonnegative balance of 1 and an amount of <amount>
When I call pay with that balance and amount
Then pay raises ValueError
Examples:
| amount |
| 0 |
| -1 |

changes.diff:
--- a/pay.py
+++ b/pay.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def pay(balance: int, amount: int) -> bool:
     if balance < 0 or amount <= 0:
         raise ValueError('Invalid payment')
-    return balance > amount
+    return balance >= amount

fixes.diff:
--- a/pay.py
+++ b/pay.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def pay(balance: int, amount: int) -> bool:
     if balance < 0 or amount <= 0:
         raise ValueError('Invalid payment')
-    return balance > amount
+    return balance >= amount
fixes.explanation: Change the strict comparison to inclusive so a payment succeeds when the balance exactly covers the positive amount. Preserve the documented ValueError behavior for negative balances and nonpositive amounts.
